To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
LMW ultrafiltrate prepared from aortic tissues is effective in the treatment of atherosclerosis and has a beneficial effect on the development of atherosclerosis.
the ultrafiltrate of the pig aorta tissue has an effect on the development of atherosclerosis, reducing the content of serum total cholesterol, low density lipoprotein and atherogenic index.
the LMU prepared from pig aortas has antiatherogenic and anti-inflammatory activity in experimental atherosclerosis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of LMU from meat by-products in the treatment of cardiovascular diseases.
the use of meat by products for the preparation of bioactive peptides and proteins, which may be used as functional food ingredients or nutraceuticals in the treatment of cardiovascular diseases.
the possibility of the use of LMU as an agent against cardiovascular disorders.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the LMU of pig aortic tissue is an effective and safe therapeutic tool for cardiovascular disorders.
LMU is a source of bioactive peptides that have a potential for the prevention of cardiovascular disorders.
the LMU from the pig aorta tissues can be used as an effective agent for the prevention and treatment of atherosclerosis and related cardiovascular disorders.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
LMW proteins and peptides from meat by products are potential bioactive molecules that may be useful in the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular diseases.
the LMU prepared from aorta tissues of pig can be used as a functional food for the treatment and prevention of cardiovascular diseases.
the use of ultrafiltrates from aorta tissues could be a promising approach for the prevention of cardiovascular disorders.
The main takeaway from our work is that
LMU is a potential candidate for the treatment of cardiovascular diseases.
LMU from pig aorta tissue can be used as an effective agent for the prevention and treatment of cardiovascular diseases.
ultrafiltrates and extracts prepared from meat by products are rich in tissue specific bioactive proteins and peptides and may have a beneficial effect on cardiovascular system.
